'''Bryan Prittie'''<ref name="dt-11938">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11938 The PowerHouse], DeckTech (Bryan "DMX" Prittie, 22 November 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11938/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11938/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018092435/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11938/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''DMX''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list on DeckTech in November 2000.
